risks.title: Economic Uncertainty and Trade Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Economic uncertainty, trade tariffs, weaker housing starts, and soft consumer sentiment negatively impacted box demand in North America throughout 2025.

risks.title: Geopolitical Tensions and Regional Conflicts
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and the Russia-Ukraine conflict contributed to macroeconomic volatility and relatively weak demand in EMEA throughout 2025.

risks.title: Weak Market Demand
risks.score_rationale: Market demand proved weaker than expected throughout 2025, although the company outperformed the market in the second half due to customer service and reliability efforts.

risks.title: Separation-Related Operational Risks
risks.score_rationale: The separation announced in January 2026 creates significant operational and governance risks, including required approvals, transaction structure, and impacts on value creation.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Volatility and Commercial Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Persistent macroeconomic volatility and commercial uncertainty in EMEA kept demand environments relatively soft throughout 2025.

ai_positioning.summary: The company IP does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 2025 fiscal year 10-K report. No strategic, operational, or technological references to AI are present.
